cues: The rate of a reaction is the change in concentration per unit time.
As a reactant R is used up, its concentration falls along a curve like this.
The average rate over an interval is minus delta R over delta t, or plus delta P over delta t for a product.
The minus sign just keeps the rate positive.
The unit is moles per litre per second.
